description: Original natural-scale measurement: CMT=1 is free ligand concentration; CMT=2 is total target concentration.

description: Natural logarithm of the numerical original DV. The model aliases DV=LNDV; do not log this column again.
notes: The reference scale is the natural-scale endpoint unit documented under DV and the endpoint selector.
